dashboard.subtitle: Access AgriYUVAN agricultural services and tools from one place.
dashboard.helpText: Get quick guidance on crops, weather, soil, and farm planning.

dashboard.generalTip2: Use local guidance and weather updates for daily decisions.

soilAnalysis.title: Soil Analysis
soilAnalysis.description: Check soil health and preparation guidance.
soilAnalysis.tip1: Review soil fertility and moisture before sowing.
soilAnalysis.tip2: Adjust nutrient planning based on field conditions.

pesticideRecommendation.title: Pesticide Guidance
pesticideRecommendation.tip1: Use pesticides only when needed and as recommended.
pesticideRecommendation.tip2: Follow safe handling and waiting periods before harvest.

weather.tip1: Track rainfall, temperature, and humidity before field work.
weather.tip2: Adjust irrigation and crop protection based on conditions.
